blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. Sale and lease listings.

Commercial property for sale in Chilliwack: industrial buildings and strata units, offices, retail space, commercial land and businesses listed on the MLS®. The search shows space for sale and for lease. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 for a property that is not listed, or to value one you own.
Commercial and industrial areas in Chilliwack

items.t: A business licence is required to operate a business in the City of Chilliwack; check the property’s zoning for the businesses it allows. ([City of Chilliwack, business licences](https://www.chilliwack.com/main/page.cfm?id=1086), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: In the second quarter of 2026, 13 commercial properties sold in Chilliwack (against 10 a year earlier), worth $27.4M in all: 5 industrial, 1 land, 0 office, 6 retail and other, and 1 multi-family.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).

Industrial space in the Chilliwack submarket (5.1M sq ft) was 0.9% vacant in the third quarter of 2026, asking $15.37 per sq ft net plus $5.63 in additional rent, with 185,000 sq ft under construction. Across Metro Vancouver vacancy was 4.0%.
Source: Avison Young, Metro Vancouver industrial market report, Q3 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
